name: Alfter (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of red with narrow white edges, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Alfter (a lion and a chequy band on yellow and red).
history: Municipal flag of Alfter; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Alfter arms — lion and chequy band
